commands_run: clan patch-decision branches\risk-analyst.clan --agent risk-analyst --action "Recommended HubSpot as lowest-aggregate-risk CRM for Brightline" --rationale "..."
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ..\snapshots; Copy-Item branches\risk-analyst.clan ..\snapshots\branch-risk-analyst.clan -Force; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ..\receipts
problems_and_friction: No command failures; the clan CLI worked first try and its 'next' hints were helpful. Minor friction: the branch file's task section includes full-html design requirements and an output schema stub that do not apply to a data-only branch agent, which required judgement to ignore. No web access meant pricing and data-centre details (e.g. HubSpot Frankfurt, Zoho Amsterdam/Dublin) are stated from knowledge as assumptions.
context_understood: I was the risk-analyst of three parallel branch agents on a CLAN document evaluating Salesforce vs HubSpot vs Zoho CRM for a 40-person Dublin ad agency, tasked with writing a GDPR/lock-in/migration/cost/support risk analysis plus a risk register into my branch namespace via clan patch-data and patch-decision.
